items.title: 鳴潮 Steam - ランチャーを使わずにゲームを起動する
items.sourceType: 海外Redditフォーラム 鳴潮総合 (公式純リンクRSS)
items.scriptOutline:
【動画・記事の完全論説・網羅的詳細】：
Right click wuwa in your library and go to properties. Click on the Launch Options bar while in the General tab. Enter the following: "D:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Wuthering Waves\Wuthering Waves Game\Client\Binaries\Win64\Client-Win64-Shipping.exe" %command% -krqlv=hd Replace D: with whatever drive Wuwa is on. Replace -krqlv=hd with whatever you selected in the launcher: -krqlv=sd -krqlv=hd -krqlv=uhd    submitted by    /u/dotbeige   [link]   [個のコメント]
